scope: Live learner replay from a fresh public GitHub clone and fresh Terraform state in a different AWS account, using profile guru/us-east-1; corrections and explicit provisioning recovery were required.

recovery.initial_failure: Worker launches terminated with Client.InvalidKMSKey.InvalidState; the regional EBS default references a nonexistent KMS key.
recovery.fix: Explicitly select enabled AWS-managed alias/aws/ebs in launch template; replace failed node group.
recovery.recovery: After EKS node group remained DELETING for more than 13 minutes, deleted its verified empty Auto Scaling group without ForceDelete.
recovery.retry: After more than 20 minutes of DELETING, isolated Terraform config uses node_group_name private-workers-retry and create_before_destroy to create corrected nodes before waiting on old group deletion; public lab name remains private-workers.

corrections.problem: Encrypted worker roots inherited a regional EBS default referring to a nonexistent KMS key; launches terminated with Client.InvalidKMSKey.InvalidState.
corrections.change: Resolve and explicitly select AWS-managed alias/aws/ebs in the launch template; retain encryption. Document selection, required KMS read permissions, and Auto Scaling launch diagnostics in both languages.
corrections.verification: Corrected private-worker group reached ACTIVE; two private workers passed IMDS options and workload tests.

corrections.problem: Published frontend restart completed Kubernetes rollout but the following HTTP request returned HTTP 502 before ALB registration/draining converged.
corrections.change: Namespace opt-in for ALB pod readiness gate injection; frontend preStop delay of 10 seconds and a 30-second shutdown grace; explain first-deploy Service/TGB dependency and injected gate checks.
corrections.verification: New frontend pods showed readiness gates 1/1; corrected published rollout completed; 28/28 HTTP samples returned 200, no observed request errors.

corrections.problem: First baseline note POST returned HTTP 503 with psycopg ConnectionTimeout while HTTP health remained 200.
corrections.change: Document baseline failure diagnosis and safe read-only retry; healthz is explicitly not a database test. No claim of a permanent root-cause fix.
corrections.verification: Both API replicas subsequently completed two direct SELECT current_user checks each (~0.5s); the repeated baseline persisted/read a note and processed its matching report. First failure retained in command attempts.

rollout_traffic.scope: HTTP GET / during the corrected published frontend restart; not a general availability guarantee

image_scan.note: The workshop application demonstrates network/identity controls; it is not approved for production release. No exception is silently granted for a missing fix.

results.check: Lab NAT no longer active or deleting
Application DNS removed; hosted zone and delegation retained
RDS-managed master secret absent or pending deletion

cleanup.note: The dedicated demo KMS key is scheduled for deletion after seven days. The pre-existing hosted zone/delegation and account-wide defaults are retained. Only the lab EKS CloudWatch log group was deleted manually after cluster deletion.

limitations: Console provisioning was documented/reviewed, not executed end to end. The tested setup path was Terraform.
Provisioning recovery used an isolated temporary private-workers-retry name and create_before_destroy after the failed group remained DELETING; the published default name remains private-workers.
The complete stack was not reprovisioned a second time after the corrections; corrected node creation, manifest rollout and shared exercises were retested on this run.
One initial database ConnectionTimeout was transient on observed retests; later success does not establish its root cause.
The traffic observation covers one controlled rollout and is not an availability guarantee.
Functional/security tests passing does not override Inspector BLOCK or establish production readiness.
Private HTTP remains ALB→frontend→API; SG/NetworkPolicy do not encrypt these hops.
